sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Cethlion was an Irish heroine or goddess. She was the buck-toothed queen of the Fomorians, an ancient Irish race. She was the wife of their leader Balor. The name also appears as Cethlenn, Ceithlenn, Céthlionn, Caitlín, and Kethlenda. Cethlion was a prophet. She foresaw the defeat of her people. The Tuatha Dé Danann would break them at Mag Tuired's second battle. Her foreknowledge did not stop her. She fought in that battle. There she wounded the Dagda, a chief of the opposing host.
